purpose: Master list of all 58 URLs and the build tracker: WordPress post type, parent page, template, build method, page stats, and status columns.
columns_to_fill_in: wp_id, page_created, content_entered, media_attached, seo_imported, schema_done, parity_qa_passed, notes
when_to_use: Step 1: create the page tree (sort by depth so parents exist before children). Keep using it through launch.

purpose: Month-0 SEO snapshot and launch parity spec: title, meta description, canonical, H1, OG data, character counts.
columns_to_fill_in: wp_id, staging_title_ok, staging_description_ok, staging_h1_ok, staging_canonical_ok, qa_notes
when_to_use: Pre-launch QA against the staging crawl; save a dated copy before each monthly SEO change.

purpose: Rank Math PRO CSV import for SEO titles and meta descriptions (UTF-8, no BOM).
when_to_use: After pages exist: fill id (or VLOOKUP by slug from a Rank Math export), delete the url_path column, compare headers with a Rank Math export, back up the database, then import.

purpose: Every media file the site uses (70): upload filename with the Manus hash removed, role, alt text, dimensions, pages using it, stock-license flag.
when_to_use: Before content entry. The files are NOT in the repo (they live on Manus storage); get them from a Manus export or the live site.

purpose: Each image use per page with the alt text used there.
when_to_use: While building pages and in parity QA (alt text is per-attachment in WordPress, so check pages that use a different alt).

purpose: Single source of truth for the 4 offices plus the brand entity: address, phone, email, hours (page and schema), directions links, issues.
when_to_use: Set up location fields / options page first; header, footer, location pages and LocalBusiness schema pull from it.

purpose: All FAQ question/answer pairs from 50 pages; answers taken from the visible HTML so internal links are kept.
when_to_use: Import into the FAQ repeater field (e.g. WP All Import + ACF); generate FAQPage schema from the same field.

purpose: Header mega menu (3 levels), header CTA, footer columns, legal links, social icons, sticky action button.
when_to_use: Build WordPress menus / Elementor nav before templates.

purpose: Cleaned copy per page: WP title, eyebrow, H1, intro, hero media + alt, hero CTAs, H2 outline, and body HTML with styling, forms, FAQs and global blocks stripped out.
when_to_use: Content entry. Service/blog/legal body_html pastes into the content field; other templates use it as the copy reference. Image src values are placeholders (/wp-content/uploads/<file>) - swap in real Media Library URLs.

purpose: Structured data per page today, what Rank Math should generate, what to keep as custom schema, and issues found.
when_to_use: Schema setup after Rank Math is configured.
